overview.description: The Ai Funds High Conviction US Equity AI-Managed ETF (HIAI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed US equity ETF powered completely a proprietary AI system that combines a market-regime forecaster and portfolio construction engine. HIAI adjusts its equity exposure from 0% to 100% weekly HIAI was launched on Aug 21, 2026 and is issued by Ai Funds.
